title: plugyard site file
description: A site: a named group of chargers that start and stop together. Any value may hold ${VAR} or ${VAR:-fallback}, which is replaced by an environment variable.

url.description: The address of the CSMS, starting with ws:// or wss://. The charge point ID is appended.

password.description: Password for HTTP Basic authentication. Keep it out of the file with ${CSMS_PASSWORD}.

insecureSkipVerify.description: Do not verify the CSMS's TLS certificate.

soc.description: State of charge at plug-in, such as 20%.

maxPower.description: The most power the EV accepts, such as 11kW. Without it the connector's maximum applies.

targetSoc.description: State of charge at which the EV stops charging, such as 80%.

curve.description: The charge curve: standard, dc-fast, or a list of [state of charge, share of maximum power] pairs such as [[0%, 100%], [80%, 100%], [100%, 10%]].

name.description: The name of the site, unique on this machine.

csms.description: The CSMS every charger connects to. A charger entry can override any part of it.

speed.description: How many times faster than real time EVs charge. Default 1.

connectRate.description: The most new connections to open per second. 0, the default, means no limit.

log.description: The cap of the site's log. Default: 3 files of 10MB.

maxSize.description: The most one log file holds, such as 10MB. At least 1kB.

files.description: How many log files are kept, from 1 to 100.

uploads.description: Where chargers may upload diagnostics when the CSMS asks for them. They may always upload to the machine the CSMS is on.

allow.description: Further hosts, by name or address, such as files.example.com. No scheme, port or path.

evs.description: EV presets, used with "plugyard exec <charger> plug --ev <name>".

chargers.description: The chargers of the site. Each entry makes one or more chargers from a Chargerfile.

model.description: Path of the Chargerfile, relative to this file.

name.description: A name for the charger, unique on this machine. Only for an entry that makes one charger.

count.description: How many chargers to make. Default 1.

id.description: The charge point ID. With count above 1 it needs {n} for the number, or {n:03} to pad it: "FAST-{n:03}".

ids.description: An explicit list of charge point IDs, in place of id, count and start.

ev.description: The EV preset plugged in when a plug names none.

config.description: OCPP configuration keys that differ from the Chargerfile's for these chargers.

csms.description: Parts of the CSMS settings that differ for these chargers.
